action_items.task: Update the reconciliation job to read the key

decisions.decision: Adopt idempotent retries with a client dedupe key (Option A); do not build the server dedupe table
decisions.rationale: Option B would block two real payments of the same amount within the window; the gateway already supports an idempotency key header so only clients need to change

decisions.decision: Rollout order: web client first, then the mobile client in the release after next

summary.summary: Architecture review on idempotent retries for payment requests. The team chose Option A (client-side dedupe key) over a server-side dedupe table, citing false-positive risk with money and existing gateway support. Rollout will be phased: web client first, mobile client in the release after next.
